change: Correct deployment semantics to independent alternatives: FC software filter OR second-XIAO hardware guard. Combining both remains optional.
previous_fc_prototype: p0-fc-filter.json (historical guard-only input profile; superseded for current implementation)
working_tree: Uncommitted implementation; hashes identify exact source and local artifacts.

deployments.fc_only: One radio XIAO -> custom FC UART4; accepts existing radio DRID directly, no second XIAO or radio firmware changes required.
deployments.external_guard_only: Radio XIAO -> independent radio-disabled guard XIAO -> stock FC; no FC filter patch required.
deployments.optional_combination: Radio XIAO -> guard XIAO -> custom FC UART4; accepts guard DRG2 input.

source_formats.1/242: DRID v1 binary, with MAVLink 2 trailing-zero restoration

policy.incoming_crc: Verified over original frame before normalization; signed and other flags rejected.
policy.normalization: Encode validated records to DRG2, preserve input component 242/243 and record bytes, regenerate sequence/CRC without interior 0xFD/0xFE. Only normalized complete frames reach native parser.
policy.ardupilot: Normal unsigned-frame/signature policy retained. Explicit base dispatch bypasses vehicle consumers. TUNNEL routing only; no local command handlers.
policy.inav: Validated frames counted/consumed. No ordinary handlers or report forwarding.

validation.host: PASS: six C/C++ ASan/UBSan executables and 31 Python tests, no skips.
validation.vendor: PASS: policy, direct-radio and actual receive adapter tests against generated ArduCopter 4.6.3 all-dialect headers under ASan/UBSan.
cases: Actual radio fc_observation/fc_health/fc_heartbeat encoders, without executing a second-XIAO firmware in the direct path.
Full record equality after normalization via independent pymavlink/base-station decoding.
Nested SET_MODE frame in raw RID: no command admission, dispatch or routing.
All known non-allowlisted message types under direct-radio and guard source IDs.
All 256 incoming sequences, literal 0xFD/0xFE, raw zero trimming, full TUNNEL padding, hidden suffix rejection and CRC corruption.
Shared message budget across claimed radio/guard source IDs.
Native signing-required rejection for both direct and external-guard inputs; virtual vehicle handler bypass.
validation.installation: Pinned source hashes verified in both scratch build checkouts.
validation.diagram: Portrait SVG rendered with librsvg and visually reviewed.

not_performed: No devices flashed or live FC settings changed.
No hardware UART saturation, flight/control-loop timing, installed FC state-change or power-fault tests.
No provisioning, eFuse or signing-key changes.
remaining_limits: Well-formed false or replayed observations remain possible; format/source IDs do not authenticate a radio, guard or aircraft.
Unsigned prototype fails closed if FC signing policy requires authentication.
Without an external guard, UART interrupt/DMA traffic reaches the FC directly; software parsing limits do not bound hardware ISR cost.
Both options require deployment-specific electrical and latency validation.
